title: Toward Satisfiability Modulo Realizability
summary: Problems complete for the existential theory of the reals ($\exists \mathbb{R}$) arise throughout discrete geometry. We introduce satisfiability modulo realizability, a SAT-based approach for solving satisfiable instances of $\exists \mathbb{R}$ whose solutions correspond to realizable geometric configurations. Our method encodes an underapproximation of a geometric problem as a SAT instance over abstract order types. Since almost all abstract order types are unrealizable, naive search is infeasible.
